auth.title: OIDC integration
auth.subtitle: Register the client in your IdP first, then paste the values here. Pocket ID does not allow changing client_id after create.
auth.idpStep1: Open Pocket ID and complete /setup if this is the first run.
auth.idpStep2: Create a public OIDC client with PKCE enabled.
auth.idpStep3: Set the redirect URI below. Do not rely on changing client_id later — in Pocket ID it is immutable after create.
auth.idpStep4: Copy the client_id that Pocket ID generated (or the custom id you set at create time).
auth.kcStep1: Paste the IdP issuer URL (Pocket ID APP_URL).
auth.kcStep2: Paste the client_id from the IdP — Knowledge Core does not invent it.
auth.kcStep3: Optionally set audience if it differs from client_id; leave empty to use client_id.
auth.kcStep4: Save to enable OIDC. You will be signed out and must sign in with OIDC afterwards.
auth.callback: Redirect URI to configure in IdP
auth.saved: OIDC enabled — sign in with OIDC
